title: Asymptotic cycle-type distribution of products of at least two independent regular elliptic matrices in GLn over growing finite fields
difficulty: The proof builds a specialized regular-semisimple character evaluation through parabolic flag counting, then controls finite-field character sums uniformly despite a character index set that changes with q.
